sql:
SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday, P.Description, P.`First Date`, P.Admission, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Admission = '-' AND L.Date LIKE '1991-10%' AND L.`T-BIL` < 2.0
